en.topic_title: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade

zh.topic_title: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade

en.topic_title: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade
en.topic_summary:
Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday received his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping on his first visit to Cairo in a decade, as Beijing seeks a greater foothold in the region against the backdrop of the US-Iran war.



China’s Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt to meet President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Photo: Egypt Gov’t.



The 21-gun salute at Cairo’s Ittihadiya Palace marked the start of a day of talks expected to cover the Middle Eas
